name: sales_code_only_nominal
why: Isolates the SALES_CODE branch of the non-arm's-length OR-rule: a market-looking SALE_PRICE with a non-empty MOD-IV sales code must still earn 0 mover points. Without this case an implementation that ignores SALES_CODE entirely passes every other fixture.

expect.arithmetic: mover 0 (SALES_CODE '26' non-empty -> non-usable sale despite $640k price) + capacity 15 (515k >= median) + need 8 (36 yrs) = 23

evidence_must_exclude.reason: flagged sale is not treated as a household move
